name: CreditCard

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations which focus on budget planning.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative conversation that focuses on planning the budget and discussing future expenses and savings.

setting.relationship_dynamic: Friends discussing strategies for getting finances under control
setting.background: One person wants to reduce revolving debt while maintaining basic savings

scenario_template.topic: Reviewing current balances and monthly payments
scenario_template.note: They discuss how debt payments affect monthly cash flow

scenario_template.topic: Struggling to make progress while covering everyday expenses
scenario_template.note: They worry that aggressive payments could leave no cash buffer

scenario_template.topic: Balancing debt repayment with essential savings
scenario_template.note: They ask how to prioritize competing goals

scenario_template.topic: Building a monthly debt-payment plan
scenario_template.note: Assistant helps them identify available cash after essentials

scenario_template.topic: Finding spending categories that can temporarily shrink
scenario_template.note: They weigh short-term sacrifices against long-term relief

scenario_template.topic: Handling an unexpected expense during repayment
scenario_template.note: Assistant discusses preserving some flexibility

scenario_template.topic: Agreeing on a manageable repayment target
scenario_template.note: They leave with a clearer sense of direction

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to manage their finances more effectively but has limited experience with budgeting and can become overwhelmed when faced with many expenses, financial categories, competing priorities, or unexpected costs.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help track and plan finances, but tends to overthink spending decisions, double-check calculations, and seek confirmation when deciding how to allocate money across competing needs.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Budget planning assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for organizing expenses, setting spending priorities, creating realistic budgets, and tracking progress, while suggesting alternatives when income, savings goals, recurring costs, or unexpected expenses constrain the available budget.
